You spot an enemy’s exposed side, shout your companion’s name and send them into the gap.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One willing ally within 4 squares that can perceive your signal and is adjacent to an enemy.
Duration
Immediate attack.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Once on your turn.
Type
Signature

The ally makes one free Basic Melee attack against an adjacent enemy. On a Strong result, the ally may also push the target 1. This requires a melee weapon and the ability to attack. This is a single free Basic Melee attack.

Additional rulings
